incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 5xx rates for /v1/chat/completions in region-us-east-1 since 1802345600. Symptoms: 500s with "variant_incompatibility" and some downstream timeouts. Affected customers reported: acct-chi, acct-zen. Incident ID INC-2026-042. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/INC-2026-042

maya (oncall): I'm on it. Looking at the logs now, initial patterns show chat requests getting routed to an \u201cinstruct\u201d variant that returns 500s.

alex: seeing the same. snippet from runtime logs around 1802345585:
```
2026-03-15T12:06:25Z runtime-router INFO route_decision project=phoenix route=chat selected_variant=galaxy-instruct-v2 reason=pin_match
2026-03-15T12:06:25Z runtime-proxy ERROR response=500 err="variant_incompatibility: model does not support chat schema"
```

priya: Confirmed. A keeper pin was applied earlier today to reduce costs for phoenix: `pin_variant: galaxy-instruct-v2` at 1802345500. That variant is for `instruct` API, not `chat`. The routing layer allowed the pinned variant to match despite API type mismatch.

sasha: This is the classic chat vs instruct mismatch. Two immediate mitigation options: (1) unpin the variant so routing can pick a chat-compatible model, or (2) patch routing to enforce api_type compatibility and remap pinned variants. I can do the unpin now. Which do we want for fastest recovery? :eyes:

maya (oncall): Unpin now please. Customer impact is ongoing. I'll coordinate comms with CS.

sasha: running unpin command:
```
# unpin on routing controlplane
rbctl routing unpin --project phoenix --route chat --actor sasha --reason "emergency: incompatible pinned variant -> 500s"
```
Output:
```
UNPIN OK  id=pin-8234 project=phoenix route=chat removed_variant=galaxy-instruct-v2
```

ops-bot: automated action: detected config drift on project phoenix, stats collector will re-evaluate.

maya (oncall): After unpin, I see traffic shift to `galaxy-chat-v1` and error rate dropping. Metrics (5m window): errors 5xx went from 28% -> 2% within 90s. Rolling logs now show normal chat responses. :thumbsup:

carol-cs: Customers reported degraded quality and errors. We've posted an incident banner to affected customer workspaces and opened CS tickets for acct-chi and acct-zen. They need ETA and mitigation summary.

alex: Root cause notes: pinning UI/API allowed variant pins without verifying compatibility by `api_type` (chat/instruct/embeddings). The pin is global per route and didn't include an `api_type` constraint. Example of the problematic config we found in phoenix:
```
routing_pins:
  - route: chat
    pin_variant: galaxy-instruct-v2
    applied_by: ops-runner
    ts: 1802345500
```

priya: Hotfix plan: immediate PR to control-plane will add a validation that prevents pinning a variant whose declared `api_types` doesn't include the route's API. PR + short-lived feature flag. I'll open the PR and push a canary within 2 hours.

sasha: Also adding an automated policy to reject pins that mix embeddings/gen/chat at the API-level. We'll add an e2e test to the deploy pipeline that simulates a pinned-incompatible variant and asserts the validation fails.

maya (oncall): Handoff: I'm wrapping this incident investigation. Error rates have stabilized. Next oncall (alex) please own follow-ups and postmortem. I'll update the incident timeline and customer comms.

alex: Taking handoff. Immediate TODOs I own:
- Track PR from priya and validate canary (owner: alex)
- Write postmortem draft with timeline (owner: alex)
- Add rule to alerting for "pin applied to route with mismatched api_type" (owner: sasha)

priya: PR opened: https://repo/pins-service/pull/487 - title: "validate pinned variant api_type against route". CI running, canary target = staging -> canary1 -> prod-phoenix.

ops-bot: metrics update: 5xx spike resolved in region-us-east-1. Latency normalized.

carol-cs: Sent customers: acct-chi and acct-zen initial postmortem notice and temporary workaround guidance. They'll get a full PM from us once we have the full root cause.

maya (oncall): Final notes for timeline:
- 1802345500 pin applied (operator: ops-runner)
- 1802345585 runtime started returning 500s for chat requests
- 1802345678 pager triggered
- 1802345740 unpin executed (sasha) -> traffic shifted to chat-compatible variant
- 1802345850 error rate back to baseline

sasha: small follow-up: we should also audit existing pins across org for cross-api mismatches. I'll run a query and publish results in this thread in ~30m.

alex: Thanks everyone. Marking incident as "mitigated" for now. Owners: alex (postmortem), priya (control-plane fix), sasha (audit + alert).

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 status changed to MITIGATED by maya. Assigned followups: P-456 (control-plane validation), P-457 (pins audit), P-458 (e2e test).

(reacts: maya :thumbsup:, alex :hammer:, sasha :eyes:)
